item.title: Good Morning Family - 30 October 2026
item.description:
Good morning Walkers!
Hello everyone!
Today is Friday, the 30 October.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be cloudy, with a low of 9 degrees and a top of 25 degrees.
There is about a 0 percent chance of rain.
It sounds like a good day for comfy clothes.
It’s Friday dance party day! Make sure you have a little wiggle today!
